p: Jerusalem was destroyed only because the people did not rebuke one another,
“Her ministers were like stags that found no pasture, … Just as this stag
“Her ministers were like stags that found no pasture, and they walked without strength before their pursuer” (Lamentations 1:6). Just as this stag
its head toward the other’s tail
the Jewish people in that generation lowered their faces to the ground and did not rebuke one another.
Jerusalem was destroyed only because they disparaged the Torah scholars in it,
“And they mocked the messengers of God and disdained His words and taunted His prophets,
until the wrath of God arose against His people,
until it could not be healed”
Until it could not be healed?
anyone who disparages Torah scholars cannot be healed from his wound.
